title: Web cursor presence
description: A web cursor presence demo, pure Contract since ENG-22524 (the Exact LLP 0281 stage-0 proof): one generated ephemeral collection, a Contract surface whose pointer stream rides a value channel with a rated publish, and two real browser clients seeing each other's latest cursor positions through generated bindings alone. The imperative DOM arm (LLP 0025) is deleted; its history lives in diary 0007.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; page boot calls ensureEphemeralCollections, not loadSchema

contract.devServer: bun install --cwd demos/cursors-web/surfaces/contract (once), then SNAPBACK_CURSORS_API=http://127.0.0.1:4425 bun run --cwd demos/cursors-web/surfaces/contract dev (Exact consumed from registry aliases; bun.lock is the pin)
contract.toolchain: node>=24, cargo, bun, published Exact packages at the committed lock, local Google Chrome with Chrome DevTools Protocol
contract.note: Pure Contract end-to-end (ENG-22524, Exact LLP 0281 stage 0): read side through the `ephemeral` binding (ENG-22479; Exact LLP 0284 §5 item 4), write side through a value channel's rated publish. The imperative DOM arm was deleted with the stage-0 landing; diary 0007 carries its record.

react.devServer: cd demos/cursors-web/surfaces/react && npm run dev (vite on 127.0.0.1:5186; SNAPBACK_CURSORS_API overrides the API origin)
react.toolchain: node>=24, npm (self-contained package: run npm install once), cargo, local Google Chrome with Chrome DevTools Protocol
react.note: Red-team control arm (ENG-22531): the same product over the same Snapback ephemeral backend and generated artifacts, with the subscribe/connection/publish glue hand-wired in idiomatic React (hooks + refs + a hand throttle). Exists to price the Contract abstractions honestly; verdict and metrics live in diary 0011.

contract: both windows boot the Contract surface over generated bindings
client B's cursor reaches client A's ephemeral BINDING through the rated publish (and vice versa), self styled distinctly
the transform sink drives the self dot compositor-only
channel + rated-publish facts are live-observable with receipts (Exact LLP 0281 §3.5)
forceEphemeralState is LOCAL-ONLY and dispose restores live state
presence stays live after the force cycle
presence recovers after an API server restart (fresh re-subscribe on socket regain, ENG-22541)
react: both windows boot the React surface over generated artifacts
client B's cursor reaches client A's subscribed overlay through the hand-throttled publish (and vice versa), self styled distinctly
the pointer glue drives the self dot through direct ref writes (synchronous with the input event)
publish facts (declared 15Hz inside the generated sustainedHz=20 budget) are live-observable with receipts
forceCursors is LOCAL-ONLY and dispose restores live state
presence stays live after the force cycle
presence recovers after an API server restart (fresh re-subscribe on socket regain, ENG-22541)
